svg.aria-label: Clouduxe Prism: A DDoS filter that runs on the machine it protects. Rust in the control plane, C and eBPF in the data path. Floods are scrubbed upstream; what reaches the server is checked at the network driver, layers 3, 4 and 7, before the kernel spends a cycle on it.
